messages:
katie li: hey all 9 new hire here. trying to run the "onboarding-ci" pipeline and it fails pulling the base image from ECR. any quick troubleshooting tips?

omar diaz: welcome katie! paste the build link and the exact error. are you on k8s agents or EC2?

katie li: Buildkite build: https://buildkite.com/redwood/onboarding-ci/builds/2
error snippet: 
```
Step: docker pull
> docker pull 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/onboarding/base:sha-abc
ERROR: Denied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/buildkite-agent-role/i-0cdef is not authorized to perform: ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability on resource: arn:aws:ecr:us-east-1:123456789012:repository/onboarding/base
```

omar diaz: classic ECR permission error. quick checklist: (1) confirm pipeline uses `imagePullSecrets` if you rely on docker creds secret, (2) if using IRSA check the serviceAccount annotation, (3) ensure the node/service account role has ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability.

infra-bot: Tip: local `aws ecr get-login-password` won't help pods. EKS pods use the node IAM role or IRSA. If using IRSA, check the service account's IAM role mapping in the AWS console.

katie li: i'm on the k8s agents. i accepted the GH app invite yesterday but i don't have permissions to view secrets yet.

omar diaz: gave you view perms in `buildkite` namespace. also noticed the pipeline was recently migrated to `buildkite-agent-sa` with IRSA; infra forgot to add ecr actions to the new role. fixing now.

omar diaz: patched role to include: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken, ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability, ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer. also re-applied the IRSA annotation to the service account.

samir gupta: FYI adding a checklist item to onboarding: if you hit ImagePullBackOff -> check secret, then IRSA SA annotation, then role ecr perms. will add to the docs.

katie li: retrying the build...

(30s later)

katie li: ✅ success — image pulled and build passed. thanks everyone! :tada:

omar diaz: welcome aboard! i'll drop a one-liner in the onboarding doc and a link to the IRSA debug steps.

samir gupta: also leaving a note: if you see `Denied` for BatchCheckLayerAvailability sometimes it's because the repo name changed (helm values) and the role policy referenced the old repo ARN. double-check repo ARNs in the policy.
